== Overview ==

Nintendo Network was Nintendo's second attempt at online services. It was available starting on the 3DS, later being added to the Wii U, and was a substantial upgrade from their previous attempt, Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection, both in terms of features and complexity. Early portions of the network reused several concepts from Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection, iterating on earlier ideas to make improvements. Though later additions, such as the introduction of Nintendo Network IDs, were wholely unique to the platform.

Nintendo Network is made up of many different services, all providing specific functionality for the console/accounts:
